limits: Readable completed records and a serial trusted writer are assumed. No power-loss atomicity, concurrent-writer guarantee or target-host durability qualification is established.
The three hypothetical continuations prove accounting behavior on isolated copies, not resumption or new execution of terminated task flows.
No new task utility, resource efficiency, dual-convergence or production Organ Credit claim is created by recovery.
Physical cancellation remains distinct from resource price; observed credit-v1 lambda is still zero.
Original credit-v1 physical returns remain -0.05 with feedback and 0.85 without; fewer reads still lose task success in that fixture.
method: Read-only review of recovery source and all four retained run JSON records, with source/input identity, reference/cold state and native-inspection receipt checks. No task execution or new recovery run performed by the reviewer.
permitted_conclusion: The complete retained research credit state, price, settlement map and predecessor chain can be reconstructed in a fresh process and agrees with the original accounting reference, while the original terminal native owner is only inspected.
relation_to_v1_review: This is a separately frozen recovery extension. It adds cold reconstruction absent from the original credit_execution v1 audit; it does not alter v1 source, task outcomes or scientific confirmation.
source_review: Restoration reconstructs accounting from original non-replayed native results and independently recomputes complete settlement contents, prices and hash predecessors; it does not call CreditAccount.settle to restore.
The reference separately feeds original responses to the original CreditAccount.settle and compares every receipt with the retained actual execution. This differs from the reconstruction path.
All credit/step/native sidecar filenames must match the exact expected contiguous set; missing terminal records are not accepted as an earlier checkpoint.

Checks include original request/result equality, sequence, native and FPT predecessors, raw FPT digest, request digest, NDU snapshot/evaluation binding, selected physical model, actual attempt budget, full price arithmetic and final expected task/credit/owner state.
InspectionOnlyOwner refuses execute requests before starting a process. Recovery uses the original binary only with --inspect, and its final anchor agrees with the retained terminal expectation.
Duplicate settlement replay leaves the recovered account unchanged. Hypothetical next messages are explicitly synthetic and are applied only to isolated account copies, never to the task owner.
